edits.text: When the user asks for the 'most expensive' or 'cheapest' variant of a product or item in stock, find all variants where 'available' is true and compare their prices to identify the correct one.
edits.reason: Merges proposals to compare prices of available variants to correctly identify the most or least expensive item.

edits.text: Before calling modify_pending_order_items, perform any other requested modifications to the order, such as shipping address or payment method, as the order status will be changed to 'pending (item modified)' and no further actions will be possible.
edits.reason: Ensures all modifications are performed before the item modification tool is called, which changes the order status and prevents further changes.

edits.text: Before calling modify_pending_order_items, remind the user to confirm that they have provided all the items they want to modify.
edits.reason: Ensures the agent asks the user if they have provided all items to modify before calling the single-use item modification tool.
